pack.name: Vidvox ISF Originals
pack.author: Vidvox (VIDVOX) + ISF community
pack.description: The official Vidvox ISF-Files collection — 327 Interactive Shader Format (ISF 2.0) generators and filters: geometry, color, distortion, blur, glitch, halftone and more. Generators are standalone audio/clock-reactive visual sources; filters process an input clip. MIT-licensed; the bundled LICENSE notice is retained. Pinned to upstream commit 395072d.
